chunks: Muhammad ibn Ya'qub narrated from al-Husayn ibn Muhammad, from Abdullah ibn 'Amir, from 'Ali ibn Mahziyar, from al-Nadr ibn Suwayd, from Abdullah ibn Sinan, from Abu 'Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:

You should say in the final prostration of the voluntary prayers after Maghrib on Friday night: 'O God, I ask You by Your noble Face, and I ask You by Your Great Name, to send blessings upon Muhammad and the family of Muhammad, and to forgive me my great sin seven times.'
ai.seo_question: What is the recommended supplication for the final prostration of Friday night nafl prayers?
ai.summary: Recorded in Shaykh al-Tusi’s *Tahdhib al-Ahkam*, this narration highlights the specific devotional practice of seeking forgiveness through the invocation of Allah’s Face and Great Name during the final prostration of Friday night nafl prayers. This practice underscores the Shia emphasis on the spiritual potency of Friday night (Laylat al-Jumu'ah) as a time for divine mercy and the intercession of the Ahl al-Bayt.
